dossier.headline: Tata Steel Q2 profit up 18%, led by India
dossier.summary: Tata Steel's consolidated net profit attributable to owners rose 18.2% year on year to ₹3,666 crore in Q2 FY27, and consolidated EBITDA rose 14% on the quarter to ₹10,665 crore, led by India operations. Nuvama upgraded the stock to Buy, and it was among the early gainers in Sunday's Muhurat session.
